$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (a cell, a row or the table) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Figma lays a cell's content out with an 8 px gap; a table cell holds inline content, so there is no gap to compare (the demos put several items in their own flex wrapper).

Label.$why: The first cell's text (the renderer marks it); on a cell entry the cell's own text.
